mostWorthwhile.text: The practice repair and second handoff were most worthwhile: Sal performed the repair, then Miro repeated the checks and demonstrated the stop. It made shared responsibility tangible.

leastWorthwhile.text: Stocking the cupboard was practical but less engaging than the fault exercise; sorting labelled parts was fairly predictable.

surprise.text: The practice panel had power at its lamp while reporting a missing signal. That distinction made the fault more interesting than a simple outage.

arbitrary.text: Using the residents' fobs after the repair initially felt unclear: I guessed it would formalize authority, rather than knowing it would lead to a second handoff.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the neighborhood handles a real fault: the practiced handoff and tested alarm make that prospect interesting, although the compatible-option menu made the sequence fairly guided.
